_llm_provider_note: llm_provider: "ollama" (free, local, default), "anthropic", or "openai". For a cloud provider, also set an appropriate llm_model (e.g. "claude-sonnet-4-5" or "gpt-4o") and set the matching API key as an environment variable (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY) - never put the key in this file. If the API key is missing, scoring automatically falls back to Ollama.
